actor: Claude Code agent (architect/QA reviewer role) on Director request, local WSL session

changes.description: Director's approval of the UX-01 written design with answers to its three review points, recorded as decision D28 in the decision register and as a Director's review section in docs/plans/2026-10-22-ux-01-design.md. 1. The official card back, which the Director located in the legacy app's asset folder: /home/andre/the-inkspire/public/assets/cards/lorcana_card_back.jpg, byte-identical to /home/andre/LorcanaOnline/public/assets/lorcana_card_back.jpg (JPEG 1468 x 2048, 486,672 bytes, SHA-256 0f022bc3422c5c0c2adf6bc09ca8196d30e0c78842e0845be7d44b024f5b1dbf), recorded in the legacy asset catalog (packages/assets/src/catalog.ts, key material.card.back) as an official source reused as-is and owner-approved 2026-07-02. The same folder's 734 x 1024 rounded copy, 3583 x 5000 upscale and recoloured variants are not used. It will be stored unchanged as a design-system asset with a manifest, and a neutral token-drawn back replaces it when official assets are off. 2. One simple control row under each deckbuilder catalog tile (Remove, quantity in the deck, Add), with pressing the card still opening it for reading (D26); the Director's alternative of click or tap to add was offered back as a choice and the Director chose the row. 3. A top navigation bar across Collection, Decks and Packs. The design's status line, the deckbuilder tile sentence, the scene's face-down card line, the fixture plan and the components table now reflect these answers; the original review-point text is kept.

UX-01 implementation plan (docs/plans/2026-10-22-ux-01-implementation.md): goal, architecture, pinned stack with no added dependency (only a development-only workspace dependency of the design system on @lorcana/presentation), global constraints, five review-focus risks, file ownership for every new component folder, fixture, asset, scene, story and test file, the closed TableSceneInput/CardRect/TableScene interfaces shared by the scene and the DOM overlay, and ten checkpointed tasks with test-first steps and exact commands: reference fixture, card back, room frame, deckbuilder, Collection binder, pack presentation, crowded match Flat tier, table scene, validation with documents and visual review, then hosted CI and the Director's visual approval. The fixture legality test uses the catalog's set_rotation_state value CoreConstructed, checked in the raw English catalog (1,770 CoreConstructed, 1,681 InfinityConstructed, 106 None, 1 Banned). No step is executed by this record.

Status lines in AGENTS.md, README.md and docs/README.md record the approved design (D28) and link the implementation plan; the docs/README.md design-system index row links the plan; the UX-01 backlog row moves to design_approved_implementation_plan_written with the plan and this record in its evidence; the documentation map classifies the plan as planning; the handoff is rewritten for this checkpoint.
